fields.title: Steam player-count record
fields.description: recordType is TOP_CONCURRENT, TOP_DAILY_PEAK, APP_CURRENT, APP_HISTORY, STEAMCHARTS_TOP, STEAM_ONLINE or ERROR. Steam API fields are passed through verbatim (concurrent_in_game, peak_in_game, last_week_rank, player_count, item), so extra fields may appear. Fields without a value are null.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The input value (game id/URL/name, or the mode name for charts) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: Endpoint that produced the record (S1-steam-api-concurrent, S1-steam-api-mostplayed, S1-steam-api-current, S1-steamcharts-app, S1-steamcharts-top, S1-steam-store-stats) or 'none' for errors.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the record was produced.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: TOP_CONCURRENT, TOP_DAILY_PEAK, APP_CURRENT, APP_HISTORY, STEAMCHARTS_TOP, STEAM_ONLINE or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Only on ERROR records: invalid_input, not_found, not_tracked, search_failed, blocked or unexpected_shape.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Only on ERROR records: what went wrong.

peak_in_game.title: Peak players
peak_in_game.description: TOP_CONCURRENT: today's peak. TOP_DAILY_PEAK: the peak of the rollup day.

player_count.title: Players now
player_count.description: APP_CURRENT: live players from the official Steam API.

currentPlayers.title: Current players (SteamCharts)
currentPlayers.description: APP_HISTORY / STEAMCHARTS_TOP: SteamCharts' latest reading, refreshed about hourly.

currentPlayersAt.title: SteamCharts reading time
currentPlayersAt.description: APP_HISTORY: when SteamCharts took the current reading.

peak24h.title: 24h peak
peak24h.description: Peak players in the last 24 hours (SteamCharts).

peakPlayers30d.title: Peak, last 30 days
peakPlayers30d.description: STEAMCHARTS_TOP: highest player count in the last 30 days.

hoursPlayed30d.title: Hours played, last 30 days
hoursPlayed30d.description: STEAMCHARTS_TOP: total player-hours in the last 30 days.

months.title: Monthly history
months.description: APP_HISTORY: [{month, avgPlayers, gain, gainPct, peakPlayers}], newest first; first row is 'Last 30 Days'.

usersOnline.title: Steam users online
usersOnline.description: STEAM_ONLINE: latest total users logged in to Steam.

usersOnlineAt.title: Users online at
usersOnlineAt.description: STEAM_ONLINE: time of the latest reading.

peak48h.title: 48h peak
peak48h.description: STEAM_ONLINE: highest users online in the last 48 hours.

low48h.title: 48h low
low48h.description: STEAM_ONLINE: lowest users online in the last 48 hours.

lastUpdate.title: Chart updated
lastUpdate.description: TOP_CONCURRENT: when Steam last refreshed the live chart.

rollupDate.title: Rollup day
rollupDate.description: TOP_DAILY_PEAK: the day the peaks belong to.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: APP_CURRENT: when the live count was read.

steamchartsError.title: SteamCharts note
steamchartsError.description: APP_CURRENT: why SteamCharts stats are missing (e.g. game not tracked).

previousPlayers.title: Previous players
previousPlayers.description: Monitoring: the same metric in the previous run.

playersChangePct.title: Change %
playersChangePct.description: Monitoring: playersChange as a percentage of previousPlayers.

previousRank.title: Previous rank
previousRank.description: Monitoring: rank in the previous run.

rankChange.title: Rank change
rankChange.description: Monitoring: positive = climbed since the previous run.

previousSnapshotAt.title: Previous run at
previousSnapshotAt.description: Monitoring: when the previous value was recorded.

isNewEntry.title: New entry
isNewEntry.description: Monitoring: true when the game was not in the previous snapshot.

sameUpstreamSnapshot.title: Same upstream data
sameUpstreamSnapshot.description: Monitoring: true when Steam had not refreshed its chart since the previous run, so a 0 change means 'no new data' rather than 'no movement'.
